text: You're looking for a dish that's quick, satisfying, and within your calorie goal. The Hamburger Steaks recipe fits the bill, ready in under 45 minutes and clocking in at 303 calories per serving. While it may not be the creamiest or cheesiest option, the flavors of the tomato sauce, Worcestershire, and mustard will still hit the spot. The serving size is generous, making it a filling choice to help you stay on track with your health goals. Give it a try!
